entry.title: Monnow Bridge and Gatehouse
entry.note: The decorated gate face looks southwest toward Overmonnow; plain face looks northeast into town. Lowest supports use a reconstructed low-water datum, requiring real river/bank fit review. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
